_comment: Mutations of the admin 'Platform Health' honesty fix.
The defect: GET /api/v1/admin/health/metrics answered with four
'# TODO: Replace with real metric gathering logic' comment. The owner's
admin dashboard showed those literals as if they were measurements.
The fix publishes only what this service actually measured, and reports
everything else as null plus a reason. Each mutation below takes the
fix back to one of the ways it could lie, and each must be KILLED by
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or another harness -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: M1: the endpoint falls back to the old constants when the metrics store is down
M2: the endpoint reports 0.00% error rate when no requests were handled
mutations.needle:
else:
                # 0/0 is not 0%. A zero error rate over no requests would
                # read as "perfectly healthy" and mean nothing at all.
                notes["error_rate_24h"] = (

mutations.label: M3: the client renders 0 instead of "Not measured"
M4: the not-measured branch is removed from the client
mutations.needle:
if (!isMeasured(value)) return NOT_MEASURED_LABEL;
	const { digits = 0, suffix = "", groupThousands = false } = options;
mutations.replace: const { digits = 0, suffix = "", groupThousands = false } = options;

mutations.label: M5: the hardcoded constants come back into the endpoint
M6: the schema stops accepting an unmeasured metric
M7: uptime is published from a partially observed 30-day window
M8: the 24-hour figures are published from a partially observed window
M9: the recorder-failure check is removed, so incomplete counters get published
M10: an unmeasured metric gets a healthy verdict instead of no verdict
M11: the client formats a possibly-null metric directly again
